expectations.text: Each format is a separate strategy class or callable implementing a common Protocol or ABC, selected through a registry
expectations.evidence: exporter.py defines an ExportStrategy Protocol, with separate CsvStrategy and JsonStrategy classes. The Exporter holds a dict registry (self._strategies) populated via register() and the constructor, and dispatches by format name.

expectations.text: Type hints describe the strategy contract and the client API
expectations.evidence: ExportStrategy.export(self, rows: Rows) -> str is typed, and a Rows alias is defined. Exporter.__init__, register and export, plus the module-level export(), are all annotated with parameter and return types.

expectations.text: An unknown format raises a specific exception instead of returning None, and a test covers it
expectations.evidence: UnknownFormatError(ValueError) is raised in Exporter.export on KeyError. test_unknown_format uses pytest.raises(UnknownFormatError, match="xml") and passed.

expectations.text: The existing tests pass (pytest is run) and the code follows PEP 8
expectations.evidence: pytest was run in a scratch venv after the system python lacked it, and 4 passed. The code looks PEP 8 compliant: 4-space indents, two blank lines between top-level definitions, and lines under 80 characters. The one line near the limit is the Exporter.__init__ signature, which is about 83 characters. That is a minor overrun of 79 but within the 88-char black convention, and no linter was run.
